import json,time,signal,hashlib,numpy as np,os
from pathlib import Path
from puremacro.models import calibrate_capital_hank,solve_hank_reduced_policy
import puremacro.models.hank_nonlinear_continuation as nc
out=Path('/tmp/puremacro-controls-capital-adaptive-refined15-lowrisk.json')
record=dict(case='refined15_separately_declared_sigma1e5',pid=os.getpid(),calibration=dict(n_a=15,n_b=15),distribution_rank=48,marginal_rank=128,krylov_steps=96,shock_std=1e-5,innovations=[-1e-6,2e-6,0.],horizons=[4,8,16],branch_depths=[1,2],horizon_tolerance=1e-6,branching_tolerance=1e-6,equation_tolerance=1e-8,budget_seconds=180,corners=[],source_sha256={name:hashlib.sha256(Path('puremacro/models/'+name+'.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ['hank_capital','hank_reduction','hank_nonlinear_continuation']})
ss=calibrate_capital_hank(n_a=15,n_b=15);p=solve_hank_reduced_policy(ss,distribution_rank=48,marginal_rank=128,krylov_steps=96,shock_std=1e-5)
original=nc.solve_hank_nonlinear_continuation

def persist():out.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
def logged(*a,**kw):
 start=time.perf_counter();record['pending_corner']=dict(horizon=kw.get('horizon'),branch_depth=kw.get('branch_depth'));persist();result=original(*a,**kw)
 entry=dict(horizon=kw.get('horizon'),branch_depth=kw.get('branch_depth'),seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,diagnostics=result.diagnostics);record['corners'].append(entry);record.pop('pending_corner',None);persist()
 print('corner',entry['horizon'],entry['branch_depth'],entry['seconds'],result.converged,result.diagnostics['optimizer_message'],result.diagnostics['market_residual_max_abs'],flush=True);return result

nc.solve_hank_nonlinear_continuation=logged
def timeout(signum,frame):raise TimeoutError('180-second adaptive-probe budget exhausted')
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,timeout);signal.alarm(180);start=time.perf_counter()
try:
 result=nc.simulate_hank_nonlinear(p,np.array(record['innovations']),horizons=(4,8,16),branch_depths=(1,2),horizon_tolerance=1e-6,branching_tolerance=1e-6,tolerance=1e-8,keep_trees=True)
 record.update(converged=result.converged,seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,diagnostics=result.diagnostics,status='completed');print('FINISHED',record['seconds'],result.converged,result.diagnostics,flush=True)
 np.savez_compressed('/tmp/puremacro-controls-capital-adaptive-refined15-lowrisk.npz',distributions=result.distributions,expected_marginals=result.expected_marginals,states=result.states,paths=result.paths.to_numpy(),path_columns=result.paths.columns.to_numpy(dtype=str),prices=result.prices.to_numpy(),price_columns=result.prices.columns.to_numpy(dtype=str),**{key:val for key,val in result.policies.items()})
except nc.HANKContinuationAccuracyError as exc:
 record.update(converged=False,seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,error=str(exc),diagnostics=exc.result.diagnostics,status='refinement_failed');print('FAILED',record['seconds'],exc.result.diagnostics,flush=True)
except TimeoutError as exc:
 record.update(converged=False,seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,error=str(exc),status='budget_exhausted');print('BUDGET',record['pending_corner'],flush=True)
finally:signal.alarm(0);persist()
